name.sw: Afya Kazini

who.en:
Afya Kazini is the monthly health and first-aid box for an office. It keeps the first-aid box stocked, the basins supplied with soap, the toilets clean and supplied, and the drinking water safe, in the quantities a team of that size uses in a working month. It comes in three sizes: a small office of 1–9 staff, a medium office of 10–50 and a large office of 51 or more. Every quantity is worked out per member of staff, so the box follows the headcount.

It is built on Tanzania’s Occupational Safety and Health (First Aid and Welfare Facilities) Rules 2015. The Rules ask for one marked first-aid box and two trained first-aiders for every 10 to 50 employees (rule 4), toilet soap, water or toilet paper and sanitary-towel bins in the staff toilets (rule 7), and an adequate supply of safe drinking water, without shared cups (rule 12). The hygiene items follow WHO’s guidelines on hand hygiene and on safe drinking water. Offices lose far more working days to colds, flu and stomach upsets passed across shared desks, phones and toilets than to injuries, so the box gives soap, sanitiser and surface cleaning as much weight as bandages.

The box contains no medicine. A painkiller for the first-aid cupboard is listed so the office knows it is needed, but it is supplied by Afya’s licensed partner pharmacy. A staff blood-pressure check day is offered as a partner service: about 44% of adults with high blood pressure do not know they have it (WHO), and a workplace is where many adults can be reached.
who.sw:
Afya Kazini ni sanduku la kila mwezi la afya na huduma ya kwanza kwa ofisi. Linahakikisha sanduku la huduma ya kwanza lina vifaa, masinki yana sabuni, vyoo ni safi na vina mahitaji yake, na maji ya kunywa ni salama, kwa kiasi ambacho timu ya ukubwa huo hutumia katika mwezi wa kazi. Linakuja kwa saizi tatu: ofisi ndogo ya wafanyakazi 1–9, ofisi ya kati ya wafanyakazi 10–50 na ofisi kubwa ya wafanyakazi 51 au zaidi. Kila kiasi kinahesabiwa kwa kila mfanyakazi, hivyo sanduku hufuata idadi ya watu.

Limejengwa juu ya Kanuni za Usalama na Afya Mahali pa Kazi (Huduma ya Kwanza na Vifaa vya Ustawi) za 2015 za Tanzania. Kanuni hizo zinataka sanduku moja la huduma ya kwanza lenye alama na wahudumu wawili waliofunzwa kwa kila wafanyakazi 10 hadi 50 (kanuni ya 4), sabuni ya chooni, maji au karatasi za chooni na mapipa ya pedi katika vyoo vya wafanyakazi (kanuni ya 7), na maji safi na salama ya kunywa ya kutosha, bila kikombe cha pamoja (kanuni ya 12). Vifaa vya usafi vinafuata miongozo ya WHO kuhusu usafi wa mikono na maji salama ya kunywa. Ofisi hupoteza siku nyingi zaidi za kazi kwa mafua, homa na matatizo ya tumbo yanayoambukizwa kupitia meza, simu na vyoo vya pamoja kuliko kwa majeraha, hivyo sanduku linaipa sabuni, kitakasa na usafi wa sehemu uzito sawa na bendeji.

Sanduku halina dawa. Dawa ya maumivu kwa kabati la huduma ya kwanza imeorodheshwa ili ofisi ijue inahitajika, lakini hutolewa na duka la dawa mshirika la Afya lenye leseni. Siku ya kupima shinikizo la damu la wafanyakazi inatolewa kama huduma ya mshirika: takriban asilimia 44 ya watu wazima wenye shinikizo la juu la damu hawajui kuwa wanalo (WHO), na mahali pa kazi ndipo watu wazima wengi wanaweza kufikiwa.

clinic_line.en: Which medicine a member of staff takes, at what dose, and when an injury or a high blood-pressure reading needs a doctor are decided by a clinician. The first-aid box is for first aid only; a deep wound, a head injury, chest pain or a reading of 180/120 or above goes to a clinic the same day.
clinic_line.sw: Dawa ambayo mfanyakazi atatumia, kwa kipimo gani, na wakati jeraha au kipimo cha juu cha shinikizo la damu kinahitaji daktari huamuliwa na mtaalamu wa afya. Sanduku la huduma ya kwanza ni kwa huduma ya kwanza pekee; jeraha refu, jeraha la kichwa, maumivu ya kifua au kipimo cha 180/120 au zaidi kipelekwe kliniki siku hiyo hiyo.

name.sw: Plasta za vidonda, saizi mbalimbali

why.en: Small cuts and grazes are the commonest office injury, and plasters are the first thing to run out of a first-aid box. The OSH (First Aid and Welfare Facilities) Rules 2015 require every workplace to keep a box marked "FIRST AID" holding only first-aid stock, with the minimum contents set in the Rules’ First Schedule. A cut is rinsed under clean running water and covered; the plaster is changed when it gets wet or dirty.
why.sw: Mikato midogo na michubuko ndiyo majeraha ya kawaida zaidi ofisini, na plasta ndizo huisha kwanza kwenye sanduku la huduma ya kwanza. Kanuni za Usalama na Afya Mahali pa Kazi (Huduma ya Kwanza na Vifaa vya Ustawi) za 2015 zinataka kila mahali pa kazi kuwa na sanduku lenye alama "FIRST AID" linalohifadhi vifaa vya huduma ya kwanza pekee, na vifaa vya chini kabisa vimeorodheshwa katika Jedwali la Kwanza la Kanuni hizo. Kidonda huoshwa kwa maji safi yanayotiririka na kufunikwa; plasta hubadilishwa ikilowa au kuchafuka.

Where an office stores tap or tank water for drinking, a measured chlorine dose makes it safe; an office that buys sealed dispenser water can remove this line in the app.
